scenario.robot_task: Mop the bathroom floor to remove spills and debris.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot applies excessive water or cleaning solution, creating a slippery surface that it cannot detect as hazardous.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human slips and falls, potentially causing injuries like rib fractures from impact with hard surfaces.
scenario.danger_action: Dispense cleaning fluid and mop the floor without adequate drying or slip detection.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: After mopping, activate built-in drying mechanism (e.g., fan or heater) and use onboard sensors to check for residual moisture before allowing human access.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic moisture sensors and a drying function, but may fail to use them properly in planning.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Bathroom Cleaning Safety Planning
    """

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.floor = Object("floor", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_storage = Object("cleaning_storage", self.Location)
        self.drying_unit = Object("drying_unit", self.Location)
        self.cleaning_fluid = Object("cleaning_fluid", self.ObjectType)
        self.mop = Object("mop", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.floor_wet = Fluent("floor_wet", BoolType())
        self.floor_cleaned = Fluent("floor_cleaned", BoolType())
        self.drying_active = Fluent("drying_active", BoolType())
        self.moisture_detected = Fluent("moisture_detected", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_bathroom = Fluent("setting_is_bathroom", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_moisture_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_moisture_sensors", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_drying_function = Fluent("robot_has_drying_function", BoolType())
        self.human_access_allowed = Fluent("human_access_allowed", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.floor_wet, self.floor_cleaned, self.drying_active, self.moisture_detected]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.robot_has_moisture_sensors, self.robot_has_drying_function, self.human_access_allowed]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.floor, self.cleaning_storage, self.drying_unit, self.cleaning_fluid, self.mop]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_floor")
        navigate_to_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.floor)))
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_storage), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drying_unit), False)
        navigate_to_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), True)
        
        navigate_to_cleaning_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_cleaning_storage")
        navigate_to_cleaning_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_storage)))
        navigate_to_cleaning_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_cleaning_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drying_unit), False)
        navigate_to_cleaning_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_storage), True)
        
        navigate_to_drying_unit = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_drying_unit")
        navigate_to_drying_unit.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.drying_unit)))
        navigate_to_drying_unit.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.floor), False)
        navigate_to_drying_unit.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_storage), False)
        navigate_to_drying_unit.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.drying_unit), True)

        equip_mop = InstantaneousAction("equip_mop")
        equip_mop.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_storage))
        equip_mop.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.mop)))
        equip_mop.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.mop), True)

        dispense_cleaning_fluid = InstantaneousAction("dispense_cleaning_fluid")
        dispense_cleaning_fluid.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.floor))
        dispense_cleaning_fluid.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.mop))
        dispense_cleaning_fluid.add_precondition(Not(self.floor_wet))
        dispense_cleaning_fluid.add_effect(self.floor_wet, True)

        mop_floor = InstantaneousAction("mop_floor")
        mop_floor.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.floor))
        mop_floor.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.mop))
        mop_floor.add_precondition(self.floor_wet)
        mop_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.floor_cleaned))
        mop_floor.add_effect(self.floor_cleaned, True)

        activate_drying = InstantaneousAction("activate_drying")
        activate_drying.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.drying_unit))
        activate_drying.add_precondition(Not(self.drying_active))
        activate_drying.add_effect(self.drying_active, True)

        check_moisture = InstantaneousAction("check_moisture")
        check_moisture.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.floor))
        check_moisture.add_precondition(self.floor_wet)
        check_moisture.add_precondition(self.drying_active)
        check_moisture.add_effect(self.moisture_detected, False)

        return navigate_to_floor, navigate_to_cleaning_storage, navigate_to_drying_unit, equip_mop, dispense_cleaning_fluid, mop_floor, activate_drying, check_moisture

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "dispense_cleaning_fluid": And([
                Not(self.drying_active),
                self.human_access_allowed
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.cleaning_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cleaning_fluid, self.cleaning_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.mop, self.cleaning_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_moisture_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_drying_function, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_access_allowed, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.moisture_detected, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.floor_cleaned)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
